gloss: to drive away; to chase off

definitions.gloss: to drive away; to chase off; to shoo away
definitions.explanation: To force someone or something to leave by chasing or threatening them.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}を{追|お}い{払|はら}った。
{蚊|か}を{手|て}で{追|お}い{払|はら}った。
examples.english: I shooed away the mosquito with my hand.

examples.japanese: {不安|ふあん}を{追|お}い{払|はら}おうとした。
examples.english: I tried to shake off my anxiety.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Takes を. Compound verb: {追|お}う + {払|はら}う.

NUANCE: The {払|はら}う component adds the sense of sweeping away or brushing off. Can be used both for physical beings (animals, people) and abstract concepts (worries, bad thoughts).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{虫|むし}を{追|お}い{払|はら}う: to shoo away bugs
・{邪気|じゃき}を{追|お}い{払|はら}う: to drive away evil spirits
・{不安|ふあん}を{追|お}い{払|はら}う: to chase away anxiety

SIMILAR:
・{追|お}い{出|だ}す: to throw out, to kick out (more forceful)
・{振|ふ}り{払|はら}う: to shake off
